Manage profile records (no login, no provider launch)

Usage: larp cc profile [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  surface  Enable or disable a profile surface (does not qualify native launch)
  add      Register a profile and create its empty state directory
  list     List profiles
  show     Show one profile
  rename   Rename a profile; its ID and state directory do not change
  forget   Remove a profile from the registry; its state directory is kept

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
